interpretation: Measurement-only packed tile_m-by-tile_k stationary-footprint occupancy. Modeled spatial idleness uses ONNXim's start-to-finish SA-active intervals, so the 128x128 modeled-idle result equals whole-SA idle. A separate conservative issue-to-finish reservation view is also reported. Neither view is cycle-accurate PE wavefront activity or an energy-saving claim. Version 3 also retains compact continuous idle-episode histograms for plug-in break-even analysis.
